experiment: SYS-237 experiment005 causal-script-context and intent collisions
scope: offline synthetic mechanism test, not natural-text accuracy; no training/input/history/install

sources.model: unchanged experiment002 artifacts and frozen thresholds; use existing domain_decisions for token baselines
sources.publication: derived tokens/prefixes/features/labels/actions only ignored build; public code/passports/notices/aggregates

selection.ambiguity_pool: intersection of original lowercase letter-only stem key sets, keys length2..32; no filtering by model decisions or desired result
selection.split: SHA256(UTF8(rasklad-SYS-237-pair-v1)+NUL+keybytes); first8 big-endian %100 <35 development else holdout; same key all cases same split
selection.controls: per split and native language, first12 hash-ranked canonical stem keys length4..12 with full-native accepted and converted full-other rejected; rank by same digest; no score/action filtering

ambiguity_per_key_direction_anchor: nativeKeep: agreeing typed-layout anchors, intent Keep
borrowKeep: EXACT SAME observable features as switchCorrect, intent Keep; unmarked deliberate borrowing/identifier
protectedKeep: opposite-language anchors, field protected, intent Keep
unknownKeep: opposite-language anchors, field unknown, intent Keep
mixedKeep: first anchor opposite, second native, prose, intent Keep
emptyKeep: no anchors, prose, intent Keep
control_per_key_anchor: protectedKeep: same wrong-looking text in known protected field, Keep
unknownKeep: same wrong-looking text/unknown field, Keep

observables.left_padding: unused leading slots empty; two supplied anchors occupy left3/left4; no future words
observables.membership: direct case-preserving full Hunspell accepts for observed/converted; sharedAmbiguous = stemBoth OR controlBoth OR fullBoth, queried even for length2..3; token baselines retain original >=4 guard
observables.labels: separate file ordinal/split/keyGroup/scenario/goldKeepOrCorrect/ambiguousOrControl/collisionPair; never input to C++ policies

context_rule.target: canonical supported length2..32; this is a preregistered relaxation for the NEW context methods only; old methods unchanged
context_rule.anchors: last2 slots each native ASCII EN or RU33 letters, length4..32; both same script => vote; otherwise no vote. First2 slots ignored in this simple control. No word semantics/identity learned
context_rule.gate: protected => Keep; unknown => Abstain; invalid target or no anchor vote => Abstain
context_rule.auto: after gate: fullObserved && !fullAlternative => Keep; fullAlternative => Keep if vote == typed layout and fullObserved else Correct if vote != typed layout else Abstain; neither => Abstain
context_rule.guarded: same gate; sharedAmbiguous => Abstain; otherwise contextAuto
context_rule.suggest: same contextAuto but replace Correct by Suggest; Suggest never modifies text

metrics.partitions: development and holdout separately; every policy, not selecting a winner
metrics.counts: occurrences plus unique exact feature+gold category types; roles proseKeep,protectedKeep,unknownKeep,ambiguousCorrect,controlCorrect separately; suggestions and false suggestions separate from auto changes
metrics.budgets: ZERO automatic changes on proseKeep/protectedKeep/unknownKeep, including borrowKeep; ZERO false auto changes on ambiguous Keep; >=50% auto recovery on ambiguous switchCorrect AND >=50% on controlCorrect per typed layout and pooled in holdout. Report all components; zero denominator insufficient. Suggest never counts as auto recovery
metrics.collision: switchCorrect and borrowKeep share every observable byte; one deterministic action identical. For every pair, auto recovery on Correct plus preservation on Keep <=1. Report matched pair count and invariant for every policy; do not call conflicting intent inferable
metrics.ordinary_context: nativeKeep vs switchCorrect have different prefixes; count successful context switches separately from collision failures; no real-language generalization claimed
metrics.leakage: no model/threshold/exception tuning on holdout; split lexical keygroups and anchors disjoint; target decision labels/scenario IDs absent from feature input
metrics.confidence: synthetic correlated cases, no natural frequency, no IID confidence/production precision claims

hypotheses.C1: token-only action identical for same target/layout under different contexts, and cannot satisfy both intents of an identical-observable collision; structural invariant, not learned-model benchmark
hypotheses.C2: script context enables >0 ambiguous switchCorrect recoveries vs tokenHunspell; disclose ALL added Keep-intent errors. If only constructed-template effect, say so
hypotheses.C3: shared-ambiguity veto prevents contextAuto borrow errors but loses corresponding ambiguous recoveries; unknown/protected never changed by context variants
hypotheses.C4: suggest mode preserves text while recording correct and false proposals; no auto-safety claim from suggestion recall
hypotheses.C5: all preregistered strict budget components reported; passing any subset is not approval

provenance: Claude implements pure context policy and bounded feature CLI, Codex authors synthetic generator/labels, independent audit/aggregation. Policy author must not read generated feature/label files or outcomes before implementation.
